Subject: Your cheque bounce matter

Dear Mr. Pandey,

Thank you for meeting us on 03/11/2020 about your dispute with Nambiar Traders. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Thiruvananthapuram.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of 33.9 lakh rupees.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Thiruvananthapuram
